relations.text: 2030年12月31日まで続く契約で、独占的な飲料供給元となっている
relations.text_en: Coca-Cola is the exclusive beverage supplier under a contract that expires on December 31, 2030 or later

source.label: ドミノ・ピザ 10-K(2025年12月28日期)
source.quote: This contract, renegotiated in December 2023, provides for Coca-Cola to continue to be our exclusive beverage supplier and expires on December 31, 2030 or at such time as a minimum number of cases of Coca-Cola products are purchased by Domino’s, whichever occurs later.
